contract: Public Pantiss site: help learners compare industry-led pathways and contact the right team. Preserve brand and source media; use calm industrial typography and semantic tokens; require stable navigation, mobile reflow, keyboard access, and deferred media. See contractDetails and site-optimization.md.

accessibility.evidence: Manual scoped checks: mobile dialog traps focus, closes with Escape, and restores the trigger; resource video dialog traps and restores focus; programme and dashboard tabs support arrow keys and match their panels; added visible focus rings, labelled controls, skip link, and native controls. This is not a full WCAG certification.

responsive.evidence: All 19 public routes were opened and scrolled at 390x844. Fixed Careers slider overflow, dashboard filter overflow, and programme decorative-background overflow. Representative programme, About, dashboard, and contact views checked at desktop; programme selector inspected at 768x1024. Screenshots captured at all three sizes.

loading.evidence: Route and deferred section placeholders reserve space before code loads; initial browser checks found no offscreen WebGL canvas or YouTube iframe on catalogue/programme routes.

empty.evidence: Navigated to /careers/jobs?category=NoSuchCategory, observed No matching roles, clicked Show all roles, and confirmed content returned.

error.evidence: Simulated a failed /map/Orissa.geojson fetch in the browser and observed the map error notice and Retry action without a page crash. Unknown-route recovery links also verified. Global React error boundary is source-checked, not force-crashed in the browser.

partial.evidence: Failed remote images render Image unavailable placeholders within their original slots; simulated map-outline failure leaves the route mounted with an explanation and retry rather than an unhandled rejection.

success.evidence: All 19 routes rendered headings and completed the mobile scroll smoke checks with no error boundary or horizontal document overflow. Programme keyboard selection, dashboard tab switching, and on-demand video creation verified.

permission.reason: This pass covers the 19 public routes; they contain no implemented sign-in or permission flow. External LMS, ERP, and alumni services were not accessed.

renderedEvidence.observation: Programme explorer after keyboard selection: focused ITI tab, readable panel hierarchy, consistent shared header and surfaces.
Contact page: compact shared header, stacked navigation and contact content, no horizontal overflow.
Programme explorer: two-column layout remains readable, long tab labels wrap within bounds, no overflow.

contractDetails.purpose: Help learners compare training pathways and reach the appropriate team; help partners and staff find projects, resources, and performance information.
contractDetails.primaryAction: Explore a programme, then contact the team.
contractDetails.direction: Calm industrial: readable Inter typography, dark neutral surfaces, green primary actions, restrained motion, semantic tokens.
contractDetails.hierarchy: Stable shared navigation, clear page title, primary action, progressively loaded sections.
contractDetails.localReferences: Existing Pantiss brand, programme data, project portfolio, and enterprise selector in the repository.
contractDetails.constraints: React 18 + Vite, no new runtime dependencies, preserve source media, mobile reflow and keyboard access, keep maps and 3D out of initial loading.
